from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and the titles of OTHER provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers in the collection that this paper explicitly references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """A collection of parsed paper instances."""
    papers: list[Paper]
